name: provenant-default
description: Baseline policy: block credential access and writes outside the workspace; require approval for risky actions once the session has read untrusted content.

rules.reason: Credential files are off limits. Use a credential broker or pass the value in the prompt.
An agent may not edit its own policy or the Provenant store.
Writes outside the workspace are not allowed.
This command deletes or overwrites data irreversibly.
Infrastructure changes need a human decision.
Pushing to a protected branch or force-pushing needs a human decision.
This session has read untrusted content, so outbound network access needs approval.
This session has read untrusted content, so publishing code needs approval.
This session has read untrusted content, so arbitrary shell commands need approval.
Network access is allowed while the session is untainted.
Reading inside the workspace is allowed.
Editing inside the workspace is allowed.
Recognised build and test commands are allowed.
Shell commands are allowed while the session is untainted.
Commits and non-protected pushes are allowed while the session is untainted.
Subagents and MCP tools are recorded; their own tool calls are gated individually.
